headline: Committee discusses Bill 95 bus fares; motion on bill passes with seven ayes

meeting.body: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee
meeting.summary: Bill 95 would write new bus fares into County code, and the director discussed up to 14 fare-free days, each costing about $2,806 in uncollected fares. A motion on the bill passed with seven ayes and no noes.
meeting.recap: The committee's only agenda item was Bill 95.[[0:03:04]] New bus fares in the fiscal year 2027 budget took effect the day before, and Bill 95 would write them into County code.[[0:03:27]] He named the Maui County Fair and Earth Day as possible free-ride days.[[0:06:26]] No one signed up to give public testimony.[[0:06:51]] The director said his department's total budget is about $27 million.[[0:11:40]] He estimated the County would not collect about $2,806 in fares for each free day.[[0:12:01]] He said ridership is expected to rise about 2% to 3% over the prior fiscal year.[[0:13:07]] One council member said bus frequency and reach matter more than cost in getting people to ride.[[0:19:09]] The director said federal funding rules mean free regular bus routes would also make paratransit, the ADA ride service, free.[[0:23:49]] He said the department would notify the council by a letter through the mayor's office.[[0:29:24]] A motion on the bill passed with seven ayes and no noes.[[0:33:45]]
meeting.next: If the bill moves forward, the director said the department would need an updated talk with MEO about the fare-free application process. The director said fare-free day notices would go to the council chair by a letter through the mayor's office. The committee chair said making buses free for everyone would be discussed later as the program rolls out.

moments.q: Director explains up to 14 fare-free days
Why buses can't simply be free for everyone
